subclasses.name: Knowledge
subclasses.summary: Clerics of gods of learning and lore who collect secrets, study esoteric knowledge, and read minds and the past.

features.name: Blessings of Knowledge
features.summary: Learn two languages and gain proficiency in two of Arcana, History, Nature, Religion; proficiency bonus is doubled for checks with those two skills.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
features.summary: Action: gain proficiency with one chosen skill or tool for 10 minutes.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
features.summary: Action: a creature within 60 ft makes a Wisdom save. On a failure you read its surface thoughts for 1 minute while within 60 ft, and may use your action to end this and cast suggestion on it without a slot (it automatically fails). On a success, you cannot use this on it again until a long rest.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to damage of any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Visions of the Past
features.summary: Meditate at least 1 minute (up to minutes equal to your Wisdom score, concentration) to see a held object's history (previous owners, recent significant events) or the recent events of the area (up to a 50-ft cube, going back days equal to Wisdom score). Recharges on short or long rest.

grantedProficiencies: Two skills from Arcana, History, Nature, Religion (expertise-style doubling)

subclasses.name: Life
subclasses.summary: Servants of gods of vitality and healing who sustain the living and drive back death.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.summary: Gain heavy armor proficiency.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.summary: Healing spells of 1st level or higher restore an extra 2 + spell level hit points.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
features.summary: Action: distribute a pool of healing equal to 5 x cleric level among creatures within 30 ft, restoring each to at most half its hit point maximum; not usable on undead or constructs.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.summary: When you cast a 1st-level or higher spell that heals another creature, you regain 2 + spell level hit points.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, add 1d8 radiant damage; rises to 2d8 at level 14.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.summary: When healing dice would be rolled for a spell, use the maximum value of each die instead.

subclasses.name: Light
subclasses.summary: Priests of sun, truth, and vigilance who burn away darkness and deception with radiance.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.summary: Learn the light cantrip if you do not know it.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.summary: Reaction when a creature you see within 30 ft attacks you: impose disadvantage on the roll (attackers immune to blinding are unaffected). Uses equal to Wisdom modifier (min 1), recharge on long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
features.summary: Action: dispel magical darkness within 30 ft; hostile creatures within 30 ft make a Constitution save, taking 2d10 + cleric level radiant damage on a failure, half on success (total cover protects).

features.name: Improved Flare
features.summary: Warding Flare can also protect a creature other than you.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to damage of any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.summary: Action: for 1 minute, emit bright light in 60 ft and dim light 30 ft beyond; enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saves against your fire or radiant spells.

subclasses.name: Nature
subclasses.summary: Champions of wild gods who hunt despoilers, bless harvests, and command beasts and plants.

features.name: Acolyte of Nature
features.summary: Learn one druid cantrip and gain proficiency in Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.summary: Gain heavy armor proficiency.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
features.summary: Action: beasts and plants that can see you within 30 ft make a Wisdom save or are charmed for 1 minute or until damaged, friendly to you and your designees.

features.name: Dampen Elements
features.summary: Reaction: grant yourself or a creature within 30 ft resistance to one instance of acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 cold, fire, or lightning damage (your choice); 2d8 at level 14.

features.name: Master of Nature
features.summary: While creatures are charmed by Charm Animals and Plants, you can use a bonus action to verbally command them.

grantedProficiencies: One of Animal Handling, Nature, Survival

subclasses.name: Tempest
subclasses.summary: Wielders of storm, sea, and sky who strike with thunder and lightning and inspire fear.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: Gain martial weapon and heavy armor proficiency.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.summary: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft hits you: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d8 lightning or thunder damage (half on success). Uses equal to Wisdom modifier (min 1), recharge on long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
features.summary: When rolling lightning or thunder damage, use Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage instead.

features.name: Thunderbolt Strike
features.summary: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can push it up to 10 ft away.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 thunder damage; 2d8 at level 14.

features.name: Stormborn
features.summary: Gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed while outdoors and not underground.

subclasses.name: Trickery
subclasses.summary: Mischief-makers serving gods of thieves and rebels who prefer deception and pranks to open confrontation.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.summary: Action: touch a willing creature other than you to grant advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 hour or until you use this again.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
features.summary: Action: create an illusory duplicate within 30 ft for 1 minute (concentration). Move it 30 ft as a bonus action (stays within 120 ft), cast spells as if from its space, and gain advantage on attacks against a creature that can see it when you and the duplicate are both within 5 ft of it.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
features.summary: Action: turn invisible for a short time (until your next turn ends); you reappear if you attack or cast a spell.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 poison damage; 2d8 at level 14.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.summary: Invoke Duplicity creates up to four duplicates; you can move any number of them as one bonus action.

subclasses.name: War
subclasses.summary: Battle-priests of gods of war who fight on the front line and bless warriors.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: Gain martial weapon and heavy armor proficiency.

features.name: War Priest
features.summary: When you take the Attack action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action. Uses equal to Wisdom modifier (min 1), recharge on long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
features.summary: After seeing an attack roll but before the result is declared, gain +10 to that roll.

features.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
features.summary: Reaction: grant +10 to an attack roll of a creature within 30 ft, chosen after the roll but before the result is declared.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 damage of the same type as the weapon; 2d8 at level 14.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.summary: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

subclasses.name: Forge Domain
subclasses.summary: A smith-god cleric who wears heavy armor, empowers mundane gear, and crafts metal items with divine rituals. Gains fire resistance, extra armor class, fiery weapon strikes, and eventually fire immunity and tough physical resistances.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: You gain proficiency with heavy armor and with smith's tools.

features.name: Blessing of the Forge
features.summary: At the end of a long rest, touch one nonmagical suit of armor or one nonmagical simple or martial weapon. Until your next long rest or until you die, it becomes a magic item with a +1 bonus to AC (armor) or to attack and damage rolls (weapon).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
features.summary: Perform a 1-hour ritual (which can be done during a short rest) using a Channel Divinity use, at a forge or similar workspace, to create a nonmagical metal item worth up to 100 gp, such as a weapon, armor, ammunition, tools or another metal object. The item appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of you and the work consumes the ritual's time rather than materials.

features.name: Soul of the Forge
features.summary: You gain resistance to fire damage, and while wearing heavy armor you gain a +1 bonus to your Armor Class.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d8 fire damage. At 14th level the extra damage becomes 2d8.

features.name: Saint of Forge and Fire
features.summary: You become immune to fire damage. While wearing heavy armor, you also have resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

subclasses.notes2024: Not reprinted in the 2024 Player's Handbook.

subclasses.name: Grave Domain
subclasses.summary: A cleric domain about the line between life and death: it protects the dying, senses undead, and punishes foes by making them easier to hurt. It also boosts cantrip damage and heals allies when enemies fall.

features.name: Circle of Mortality
features.summary: When you cast a healing spell that restores hit points to a creature at 0 hit points, the healing dice count as their maximum possible result. You also learn the spare the dying cantrip, and it does not count against your cleric cantrips known. Spare the dying has a range of 30 feet when you cast it.

features.name: Eyes of the Grave
features.summary: As an action, you sense the location of any undead within 60 feet that is not behind total cover and is not protected from divination magic. This lasts until the end of your next turn. You learn only where they are, not what they are. You can use this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), regaining all uses after a long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
features.summary: As an action, you use Channel Divinity to curse a creature you can see within 30 feet. The next time you or an ally hits that creature with an attack before the end of your next turn, the creature is vulnerable to all of that attack's damage, and the curse then ends. The curse has no effect on a creature that is immune to the damage of that attack.

features.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
features.summary: As a reaction, when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet suffers a critical hit, you can turn that hit into a normal hit. Any other effects triggered by the critical hit are negated as well. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), regaining all uses after a long rest.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.summary: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Keeper of Souls
features.summary: Once per turn, when an enemy you can see dies within 60 feet of you, you or one ally within 60 feet of you regains hit points equal to the number of hit dice that enemy had (or its level, if it has one). You must not be incapacitated to use this.

subclasses.notes2024: Not reprinted in the 2024 Player's Handbook.
